title: PHP7, Laravel 5.2, LaraVer, and interviews with Colin O'Dell and Mike Bronner
content: LN06: We're joined by Colin O'Dell and Mike Bronner this week. Colin talks to us about new features in PHP7, Mike talks to us about Laraver.xyz and Eric and Jack talk about stuff we've heard about Laravel 5.2, Flexbox Froggy, Lets Encrypt
